people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and delight in my people; and the voice of weeping and the voice of crying will be heard in her no more.
translations.bsb: I will rejoice in Jerusalem and take delight in My people. The sounds of weeping and crying will no longer be heard in her.
translations.kjv: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
translations.asv: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people; and there shall be heard in her no more the voice of weeping and the voice of crying.
